result:
I've fixed all four findings (F-DG5-120, 122, 140, 141) and every acceptance check passed. Each fix has a regression test that failed before the fix and passes after. The changes are uncommitted in `/home/user/wt/dg5-fe-rg1`, and the DG4 historical validator exits 0 at both start and end. The full suites (`pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration`, full e2e) were not run, per D-164. **What changed** - **F-DG5-120 (Medium):** a new "Critical dependency slips" section lists each affected initiative with its forecast finish before → after and the change in days. - It is the first section on the Dependencies page and is also on the affected initiative's page. A date that can't be computed shows as Unknown, never blank or 0. - My Work and the inbox reminder now show the actual message (dependency, days late, initiative codes) instead of "open the record for details". - It uses the existing `dependency-slips` API; no contract change. - **F-DG5-122 (Low):** the playbook reader no longer shows raw Markdown tables. - B0024 in the About panel renders as a table, list previews and search snippets show cells as plain text, and `
` in cells becomes a real line break. - The one-cell callouts (B0016, B0124) wrap inside the page at 1280 px, 390 px and 200 % text. - **F-DG5-140 (Low):** a user without `procedure.launch` (e.g. the auditor) now sees a read-only note on My procedures instead of the launch form. The e2e still confirms the server returns 403 and creates nothing. - **F-DG5-141 (Low):** test 6 is split into 6a (390 px) and 6b (200 % text), with the same assertions and screenshots, a 60 s budget each, and per-screen timing notes. - I measured each half at 6.8–10.2 s on a small database. - I couldn't reproduce the full-suite slowdown here, so only the orchestrator's full run proves this fix. **Results** | Check | Locale unset | C.UTF-8 | |---|---|---| | typecheck, build, lint, prettier, openapi:lint | all exit 0 | — | | `unit-web` | 1746/1746 | 1746/1746 | | Plain stack: 3 new specs + `p4-dashboards`, en + ar | 24/24 | 24/24 | | Demo stack: the slip spec (domain reviewer's reproduction), en + ar | 2/2 | 2/2 | **Failures along the way (all logged in the evidence folder)** - My first Arabic text broke the glossary test: I wrote التحول without the shadda (it must be التحوّل). Fixed and rerun. - Two defects in my own new specs failed the first after-fix run (a bad row locator, and a check that wrongly flagged B0005's verbatim "Version 1.0 | September 2026"). Fixed; product code unchanged. - One C.UTF-8 run failed with "no space left on device". I deleted my temporary files and the rerun passed. The shared disk was still about 99 % full when I finished, so your merged-tree runs could hit the same limit. **Decision for you:** a user who can launch procedures, but isn't one of a particular procedure's launch roles, still sees that procedure and gets the server's refusal message. Hiding it per procedure would need a contract change, either role codes in `GET /me` or a "launchable" flag on the definitions list, so I didn't do it. The ADRs stay accurate; the handback suggests small additions to ADR-0044 §7 and ADR-0049 for the architect. Screenshots in en and ar are under `shots/` and `shots-demo/` in the evidence folder. Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/`: - T-DG5-FE-RG1-frontend-ux-engineer.md - T-DG5-FE-RG1-evidence/
